description: Search and page through products for the storefront UI.

image_url.description: Public image URL for visual search. Combine with `query` for text + image.

page_token.description: Token from a previous response's next_page_token.

query.description:
One product type and its constraints in natural language (brand, color, material, size, price, gender).
Good: "red leather jacket under $200"; "leather golf glove under $40".
Bad: "gift ideas for dad"; "cool sneakers"; "golf glove or rangefinder".

name: browse_products
title: Browse Products
